sources.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.7 MiniCPM-V is a series of efficient multimodal large language models developed by OpenBMB. Like MiniCPM-V 4.6, the MiniCPM-V 4.7 architecture pairs a SigLIP vision encoder that has a window-attention merger with a Qwen3.5 language model backbone, and supports both 4x and 16x visual downsampling modes.

sources.title: openbmb/minicpm-v4.7
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.7 is the latest model in the MiniCPM-V series, released in two variants — 1B (dense) and 35B-A3B (MoE, the first MoE model in the series). It builds on the family's single-image, multi-image, and video understanding capabilities, combining stronger foundation capabilities with efficient visual encoding and on-device inference.

sources.snippet: The most notable models in the series currently include: MiniCPM-V 4.6: 🔥🔥🔥 The latest and most efficient model in the MiniCPM-V series. With a total of 1.3B parameters, it surpasses larger models like Gemma4-E2B-it in performance, while showing superior efficiency than smaller models like Qwen3.5-0.8B (achieving ~1.5x token throughput).
